title: refactor: simplify Gen client request handling
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Centralizes authenticated Gen requests and fatal errors across Polli CLI commands while preserving binary responses, caller headers, 402 guidance, messages, and exit code 1.
- Centralizes SDK JSON GETs and MCP chat, media, and live-capability web-search requests while preserving package-specific response and error contracts.
- Keeps Sirius request handling app-local while folding its one-caller builder and retry wrapper into the generation client.
- Removes 301 net lines across 19 files (179 additions, 480 deletions).

Checks:
- CLI build and deterministic auth/header/402/error/exit assertions
- SDK: 30 tests, typecheck, and build
- MCP syntax plus deterministic request, media, search-capability, auth, and error assertions
- Sirius TypeScript and Vite build
- Removed-symbol reference scan
- Biome and `git diff --check`

gist.headline: One path through the hive
gist.blurb: The request plumbing got a careful pruning. Polli CLI, SDK, MCP, and Sirius now share less duplicated wiring while keeping their familiar responses intact.
gist.summary: Centralized authenticated Gen requests, fatal-error handling, SDK JSON GETs, and MCP chat/media/live-search calls, removing 301 net lines across 19 files while preserving binary responses, headers, 402 guidance, package contracts, and exit behavior.
gist.impact: CLI, SDK, MCP, and Sirius maintain their existing request and error behavior, with a smaller shared code surface that is easier to maintain consistently.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a cozy garden plumber, replacing a tangle of duplicate request pipes from CLI, SDK, MCP, and Sirius terminals with one tidy central irrigation line; small code-plants receive the same water, representing preserved behavior despite simpler internals.
